115:
SELECT (CAST(COUNT(client_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(client_id) FROM client)) * 100
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
AND district.A4 = (SELECT MAX(A4) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia')
AND client.gender = 'M'	----- bird -----	financial
198:
SELECT AVG(CAST(SUM(b.bond_type = '-') AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id))
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'	----- bird -----	toxicology
201:
SELECT CAST(SUM(a.element = 'c') AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) > 1	----- bird -----	toxicology
218:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) * 100
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'	----- bird -----	toxicology
